environment.description: Deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) in a public subnet with direct internet access. The Flask app runs behind an nginx reverse proxy with basic TLS termination. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The instance has an IAM role with ec2:Describe*, s3:GetObject on sensitive buckets. No additional request filtering or inspection is configured on the nginx layer or at the network level. The container runs as root with full /bin/sh access.
